title: Fusion-driven oncogenic programs shape the immune landscape in translocation renal cell carcinoma.
snippet: Renal cell carcinomas (RCC) comprise multiple molecularly distinct cancers but most are treated empirically with therapies designed for clear cell RCC (ccRCC), the most common subtype, due to incomplete understanding of subtype-specific biology.
